   <media:description>LangChain shipped in October 2022 as an open-source project for chaining prompts and PDFs, and it now covers the whole agent development lifecycle. LangGraph is the orchestration layer, built on nodes and edges, while the LangChain framework gives you a tool-calling loop you customize with middleware. Deep Agents is a harness with summarization and file systems built in.

LangSmith covers the harder part, getting an agent reliably to production. Evals test it before launch, and traces show what it does once it's live. For enterprise governance, LLM Gateway enforces cost limits and detects sensitive data.

#LangChain #AgentFrameworks #AgenticAI</media:description>
